subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw core recognize `openclaw-even-g2-node` with `platform: "even-hub"` and `deviceFamily: "glasses"` as a canonical native setup-code bootstrap client that receives the existing bounded operator handoff?
rationale: The code is small and tested, but the choice changes a Gateway auth trust boundary and settles a durable wire-level identity for an external glasses app; automation cannot decide that product/security contract.

options.title: Approve after rebase
options.body: Accept the proposed client id and metadata contract, require the branch to resolve the dirty merge state, and leave app placement plus command policy to the related product issue.

options.title: Rename or generalize first
options.body: Ask the contributor to switch to the maintainer-preferred durable id, such as an Even Hub family id, and refresh the external app/proof before merge.

options.title: Keep external for now
options.body: Do not add a core bootstrap identity yet; keep Even Hub on generic node/plugin paths until maintainers choose a first-party or plugin ownership model.

recommendation.title: Approve after rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed client id and metadata contract, require the branch to resolve the dirty merge state, and leave app placement plus command policy to the related product issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing history is recent Gateway auth/protocol and client package work adjacent to this security-boundary decision.
